raw:
Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly identified the number of valence electrons for Selenium (Se). Selenium is in Group 16 (the chalcogens) of the periodic table. Elements in Group 16 have 6 valence electrons (ns²np⁴ configuration), not 5. The Planner confused the group number with the valence electron count or misremembered the group assignment, leading to the selection of option B (5) instead of the correct option C (6). This is a fundamental error in applying periodic table trends to determine atomic properties.
